text:
The plate is probably a dinner plate of about 26 cm.

Items:
- Two slices of bread, one toasted and one with jam. Each slice is roughly 11 cm square, about 30-35 g, so about 65 g of bread. Jam adds about 15 g. Together that is roughly 80 g and 200 kcal (bread about 170 kcal, jam about 40 kcal).
- One apple of medium size, about 150 g and 80 kcal.
- Two egg bites or muffins, each about 45 g, so about 90 g. At roughly 1.6 kcal/g that is about 150 kcal.

Total mass is about 80 + 150 + 90 = 320 g. Total energy is about 200 + 80 + 150 = 430 kcal.
